data.explanation: This is the final bill for your electricity supply at Lindenweg 12, issued because you moved out. It covers extra consumption of 212 kWh plus the base fee, with 19% VAT. Pay €105.58 to the IBAN printed on the invoice, using the invoice number as the reference. The payment is due within 30 days of the invoice date; the app shows the exact date. If you don't pay, you may receive reminders and fees. Check the meter reading and amounts against your own records.
